verdict.rationale: Shopify's Admin API documentation confirms a scoped-token model ('Your code obtains an access token scoped to the permissions it needs'), which is the standard mechanism any API consumer—including an AI agent—would use to get least-privilege credentials. However, there is no evidence of an agent-specific credential issuance flow, dashboard, or fine-grained permission UI tailored to AI agents beyond the generic OAuth app scoping. Missing for 10: agent-specific credential/permission management UI, documentation explicitly tying scope selection to agent use-cases, and independent confirmation that scoped tokens work seamlessly with UCP/MCP agent flows.
